name: fmp_insider_trading
description:
Insider transactions for one company from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/insider-trading): purchases, sales and option exercises by officers, directors and major holders, with dates, shares and prices.
Returns {symbol, transactions_count, transactions}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased), limit (integer, number of transactions; default 20).
For fund ownership use fmp_institutional_holders or fmp_mutual_fund_holders; for US Senate trades fmp_senate_trading.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 10}

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL)
